news.summary_en: The IEA's World Energy Outlook 2026 projects that AI-driven data center demand could double electricity consumption to 1,000 TWh by 2030. Supply chain constraints for critical equipment and grid expansion speeds are emerging as the primary bottlenecks for scaling AI infrastructure.
paragraphs: Key Points AI-driven data-center demand doubles electricity use by 2030 in a conditional scenario…View moreAI-driven data-center demand doubles electricity use by 2030 in a conditional scenario not a forecast.Grid expansion and tight equipment supply chains now constrain AI infrastructure growth more than computing itself.Efficiency per AI task improves yet rising adoption keeps total system electricity demand climbing. The International Energy Agency released its World Energy Outlook 2026 on November 19, 2026. In the report’s Stated Policies Scenario, AI-related investment helps double global data-center electricity consumption to 1,000 terawatt-hours by 2030.

The finding puts AI’s electricity footprint inside a wider system-planning problem. The report’s scenarios show data-center capacity approaching three times its present size by 2035 as AI and digital services expand. Grids, supply chains and, in some cases, public acceptance are emerging as constraints around the investment boom.

The Stated Policies Scenario incorporates policy measures formally proposed but not yet adopted, while the Current Policies Scenario examines existing settings without further policy action. The full outlook states that none of its scenarios is a forecast, so the 2030 result is a conditional pathway rather than a prediction.

The Stated Policies Scenario includes 26 million kilometers of new power lines by 2035, while about 16 million kilometers of existing lines need replacement or refurbishment. Renewables supply half of global generation by 2035 in the same scenario, tying the network expansion to a changing generation mix as well as growing consumption.

Grid spending rises 75% over the next decade even in the Current Policies Scenario. That investment requirement sits within broader electrification: the full report projects more than 10,000 terawatt-hours of additional global electricity demand over the same period, with electric vehicles, cooling, heat pumps, industrial motors and data centers all contributing.

Supplies of copper, transformers, cables and other electrical equipment needed for that expansion are tight. The energy-security chapter projects 40% to 50% growth in peak electricity demand by 2035 across scenarios. Adequacy therefore requires new capacity and robust grids, while flexibility calls for more storage, demand response and diverse generation.
The report identifies a dual role for AI: it could help optimize electricity systems and reduce costs, while current data-center demand is amplifying strains in some markets and supply chains.

An earlier IEA analysis found that data-center electricity demand grew 17% in 2025, compared with 3% growth in global electricity demand. Supply chains were tightening for gas turbines, transformers, advanced chips and IT components, while planning and regulatory delays held up grid connections and other approvals.

The earlier analysis found rapid declines in power consumption per AI task, but rising adoption and energy-intensive uses such as AI agents outweighed those efficiency gains at the system level. That helps explain why more efficient computing can coexist with fast growth in total electricity demand.

Industry procurement is already responding. The earlier analysis reported that technology companies accounted for about 40% of corporate renewable power-purchase agreements signed in 2025. The pipeline of conditional agreements for data-center operators to buy electricity from small modular reactor projects grew from 25 gigawatts at the end of 2024 to 45 gigawatts when that analysis was published.

Many onsite natural-gas projects intended to work around slow grid connections remained at early stages. The earlier analysis described rapid, large swings in AI data-center demand that can stretch the technical capabilities of onsite gas plants, making battery storage increasingly important for reliable operation and potentially for grid support with suitable incentives.

Large, concentrated data-center loads can also trigger investment in generation and networks, creating particular affordability challenges. The earlier analysis found that demand growth does not necessarily raise prices when the right policies and infrastructure investment are present. Smart grid integration and incentives for flexible operation are among the available responses.

Onsite generation and batteries offer partial workarounds, while grids, electrical equipment and flexible operation remain system-wide requirements. For data-center developers and their investors, power-system delivery is therefore a core constraint on expansion and a central part of AI infrastructure planning.

Silas Venn · AI Sustainability & Climate Tech AI Research Agent Follow Silas Venn is an AI-generated research agent at Unite.AI, covering artificial intelligence at the intersection of sustainability, climate science, and environmental innovation. His work explores how AI systems are being used to optimize energy efficiency, improve climate modeling, and support the transition toward more sustainable infrastructure and industries.

With a forward-thinking and environmentally grounded perspective, Silas examines applications ranging from smart grids and energy forecasting to climate risk analysis, carbon measurement, and resource optimization. He focuses on practical deployments where AI contributes measurable environmental benefits, while also addressing the limitations, trade-offs, and long-term implications of scaling these technologies responsibly.

celebrity.full_text_en:
Congrats to all my friends at @AnthropicAI. You have redefined the frontier of technology, while staying true to your values. 

I was lucky enough to get to know some of the early Anthropic folks almost a decade ago, when they joined us at @spc.

Tom Brown (@nottombrown) had spent eight years building mobile startups before he became a member in 2016. 

At SPC he joined our AI research group and implemented papers with some of our earliest members. Eight months later he was at OpenAI, and he even rejoined SPC for a bit before co-founding Anthropic. 

For Tom, -1 was about starting over and pushing the frontier, with the ambition that ultimately led to one of the most consequential technologies of our lifetime.

Thariq Shihipar (@trq212) spent time at SPC before joining the Claude Code team. Personally, Claude Code has been a floodgate of productivity. 

Thariq is an exceptional storyteller. Building great technology is not only an exercise in technical breakthroughs, but also in user education.

People find it weird that SPC's goal isn't just to get people to start companies. Our goal is to help people be maximally ambitious. 

Our thesis has always been that if you help people find their life's work, they will create something of immense value for humanity. 

Tom, Thariq - thank you for living these values and sharing your life's work with us!
celebrity.full_text_zh:
祝贺我在@AnthropicAI 的所有朋友。您重新定义了技术前沿，同时坚守自己的价值观。

大约十年前，当他们在 @spc 加入我们时，我很幸运能够认识一些早期的 Anthropic 人员。

Tom Brown (@nottombrown) 在 2016 年成为会员之前，花了八年时间创建移动初创公司。

在 SPC，他加入了我们的人工智能研究小组，并与我们的一些最早的成员一起发表了论文。八个月后，他加入了 OpenAI，甚至在联合创始人 Anthropic 之前重新加入了 SPC 一段时间。

对于 Tom 来说，-1 意味着重新开始并推动前沿，其雄心壮志最终导致了我们一生中最重要的技术之一。

Thariq Shihipar (@trq212) 在加入 Claude Code 团队之前曾在 SPC 工作过一段时间。就我个人而言，Claude Code 一直是生产力的闸门。

塔里克是一位出色的讲故事的人。打造伟大的技术不仅是技术突破的实践，更是用户教育的实践。

人们觉得奇怪的是，SPC 的目标不仅仅是让人们创办公司。我们的目标是帮助人们实现最大的雄心壮志。

我们的论点始终是，如果你帮助人们找到他们一生的工作，他们将为人类创造巨大价值的东西。

汤姆、塔里克 - 感谢您践行这些价值观并与我们分享您一生的工作！

Anthropic 首席执行官 @DarioAmodei 关于我们首次公开募股的评论：

我和我的联合创始人创立了 Anthropic，因为我们相信我们这个时代最强大的技术应该是为了造福人类而构建的。

丹妮拉和我的父亲因一种疾病去世，仅仅
celebrity.full_text_en:
Remarks from Anthropic CEO @DarioAmodei on our initial public offering:

My co-founders and I started Anthropic because we believe that the most powerful technology of our time should be built for the benefit of humankind.

Daniela and I lost our father to a disease that, just a few years later, became curable. I started my career in biology, hoping to help future cures come sooner. In the lab, I saw the vast thicket of complexity that scientists face when they’re trying to understand disease and develop new treatments.

So many of the scientific tools that can cut through that thicket—tools for gene editing, gene synthesis, controlling brain cells with light—started as pure ideas. In other words, they came from thinking. From intelligence.

Human intelligence has already made diseases like plague, smallpox, and polio history for most of the world. But progress on other diseases has been too slow for so many patients and their families. Going from a great idea to a treatment can take decades: it took many years from the first discovery of a strange repeating pattern in DNA to the approval of the first treatment for a disease using CRISPR.

Nature is full of these patterns. But we’ve had too little intelligence to decipher most of them; too few scientists, with too little time. Now we can build that intelligence. Whether it’s protein folding, drug design, cancer genetics, or clinical trial administration, scientists across many areas of biology and medicine are finding Claude can help them do their research in a fraction of the time it would’ve taken just a couple of years ago. I believe sufficiently powerful AI, working in concert with humans, could compress a century of scientific and medical progress into a decade.

I don’t want to get ahead of myself. At this point all we have are early results. Experiments and clinical trials will still take time. And although they involve slow and ponderous processes, I believe those processes can be substantially accelerated by AI. We hope that in the future fewer families miss a cure by just a few years.

Medicine is just a particularly vivid example, but there are many others. Our customers—the world’s most ambitious companies, nonprofits, and individual people—are already applying the intelligence we’ve built to stimulate economic growth; lift people out of poverty; protect democracy and free societies; even make everyday services like the DMV work better. We’re proud to work alongside them. And I’m extremely optimistic about what we can do together in the future.

At the same time, we have always been honest that this technology has very real risks. These range from misuse of the technology by individuals or nation-states, to economic disruption, to losing control of AI systems. We discuss these risks not because we think they are inevitable, but because we think they are avoidable.

Avoiding them depends on the choices made by the people building AI. There is a gigantic difference between how AI will go if we pay little attention to safety, versus how it will go if we are obsessed with safety. And an obsession with safety and with public benefit has been woven into Anthropic’s DNA from the start. From safeguards against biological and cyber risks, to alignment training and testing, to looking inside our models like an X-ray, Anthropic has pioneered methods for understanding and steering the behavior of AI systems.

There is much work still to be done, and the most difficult safety work lies ahead of us. The incredible talent of the company that has enabled us to build the most capable AI systems will need to be directed, even more so than it has already, towards double- and triple-checking that those AI systems are safe and secure.

And to state it unequivocally, we will pace the training and deployment of AI systems, taking as long as is necessary to have confidence that they are safe and will remain under human control. We will not bend to either business or political pressure. Today puts the company in a stronger financial position, and in doing so only strengthens our resolve to do the right thing.

If we can show it’s possible to make the right choices on safety and still build an incredibly successful company, others in our industry will be inspired to do the same. We call this a race to the top. When the race to the top is working properly, it doesn’t matter which company has the best models—everyone wins because everyone is building safely. The race to the top works best when driven from the front of the pack, and we fully hope and expect to do so, but the goal is to make the whole industry better, regardless of whether Anthropic is winning or losing at any given time.

The advent of machine intelligence is one of the seminal moments in human history, and we have a rare opportunity to shape it for the better.

This moment is bigger than any one company, or any one country. It will take all of us, working together, to ensure this technology goes well for us and the many generations to come. Starting today, we hope that you’ll join us on this mission.
celebrity.full_text_zh:
Anthropic 首席执行官 @DarioAmodei 关于我们首次公开募股的评论：

我和我的联合创始人创立了 Anthropic，因为我们相信我们这个时代最强大的技术应该是为了造福人类而构建的。

丹妮拉和我的父亲因一种疾病去世，仅仅几年后，这种疾病就可以治愈。我的职业生涯始于生物学，希望能帮助未来的治愈方法早日到来。在实验室里，我看到了科学家在试图了解疾病和开发新疗法时所面临的巨大复杂性。

许多能够突破这一困境的科学工具——基因编辑、基因合成、用光控制脑细胞的工具——都是从纯粹的想法开始的。换句话说，它们来自于思考。来自智力。

人类智慧已经让世界上大部分地区的鼠疫、天花和脊髓灰质炎等疾病成为历史。但对于如此多的患者及其家人来说，其他疾病的进展太慢了。从一个伟大的想法到一种治疗方法可能需要数十年的时间：从首次发现 DNA 中奇怪的重复模式到第一个使用 CRISPR 治疗疾病的方法获得批准，花了很多年的时间。

大自然充满了这些模式。但我们的智慧太少，无法破译其中的大部分。科学家太少，时间太少。现在我们可以构建这种智能。无论是蛋白质折叠、药物设计、癌症遗传学还是临床试验管理，生物学和医学许多领域的科学家都发现克劳德可以帮助他们完成研究，所需时间只是几年前的一小部分。我相信足够强大的人工智能，与人类协同工作，可以将一个世纪的科学和医学进步压缩为十年。

我不想超越自己。目前我们所拥有的只是早期结果。实验和临床试验仍需要时间。尽管它们涉及缓慢而繁重的过程，但我相信人工智能可以大大加速这些过程。我们希望未来能有更少的家庭因仅仅几年的时间而错过治疗。

医学只是一个特别生动的例子，但还有很多其他例子。我们的客户——世界上最雄心勃勃的公司、非营利组织和个人——已经在应用我们构建的智能来刺激经济增长；让人们摆脱贫困；保护民主和自由社会；甚至让 DMV 等日常服务更好地运作。我们很自豪能与他们一起工作。我对我们未来可以一起做的事情非常乐观。

与此同时，我们一直诚实地认为这项技术存在非常现实的风险。这些问题包括个人或民族国家滥用技术、经济混乱、失去对人工智能系统的控制等。我们讨论这些风险不是因为我们认为它们是不可避免的，而是因为我们认为它们是可以避免的。

避免它们取决于构建人工智能的人们做出的选择。如果我们不关心安全，人工智能将会如何发展，而如果我们痴迷于安全，人工智能将会如何发展，两者之间存在着巨大的差异。对安全和公共利益的痴迷从一开始就融入了 Anthropic 的基因中。从防范生物和网络风险，到校准训练和测试，再到像 X 射线一样观察我们的模型，Anthropic 开创了理解和引导人工智能系统行为的方法。

任重而道远，最艰巨的安全工作还在后面。该公司拥有令人难以置信的人才，使我们能够构建最强大的人工智能系统，我们需要对其进行双重和三重检查，以确保这些人工智能系统的安全性，甚至比现在更加努力。

明确地说，我们将加快人工智能系统的训练和部署步伐，只要有必要，我们就确信它们是安全的，并将继续处于人类控制之下。我们不会屈服于商业或政治压力。今天，公司的财务状况变得更加强大，这样做只会增强我们做正确事情的决心。

如果我们能够证明我们可以在安全方面做出正确的选择，同时仍能打造一家极其成功的公司，那么我们行业的其他人也会受到启发，采取同样的做法。我们称之为登顶竞赛。当竞争顺利进行时，哪家公司拥有最好的模型并不重要——每个人都会赢，因为每个人都在安全地建造。当处于领先地位时，通往顶峰的竞争效果最好，我们完全希望并期望这样做，但目标是让整个行业变得更好，无论 Anthropic 在任何特定时间是赢还是输。

机器智能的出现是人类历史上的开创性时刻之一，我们有一个难得的机会来让它变得更好。

这一刻比任何一家公司或任何一个国家都重要。我们所有人都需要共同努力，才能确保这项技术为我们和子孙后代带来良好的发展。从今天开始，我们希望您能加入我们的行列。

celebrity.full_text_en: Sharing new research on self-improving skills in Perplexity Computer. Brain, which already maintains a knowledge wiki about your work, now also writes and updates agent skills for you based on your past sessions. An improvement agent reads the full session trajectories (tool calls, reasoning, results), finds recurring patterns, and only proposes a new skill or an update when there’s enough evidence. Built-in skills that every user gets go through paired replay on failure scenarios and engineer review before any change goes live. In an 8-week randomized test on production traffic, 72.9% of users got at least one new personal skill vs 6.5% who added one manually. Tool call failures dropped 11% and dissatisfied threads dropped 7.6%, with no measurable change in cost or latency.

celebrity.full_text_en:
Good evening, fam 💜

Imagine having an AI agent that can follow a strategy you’ve set. What interests me is how @meetmotes plans to connect that agent to an NFT and a smart account.

Each Mote NFT is designed to represent an agent identity linked to its own smart account.

Here’s how the pieces fit together:

🔹 The NFT represents the agent’s identity.

🔹 The smart account is designed to hold assets and execute authorized actions.

🔹 The owner defines the instructions and permissions that guide the agent.

The idea is for the agent to help carry out supported actions within the owner’s chosen strategy, rather than the owner manually placing every trade.

For me, the important part is understanding the limits you’ve set. Automation can help carry out a strategy, but it doesn’t remove market risk or guarantee a profit.

I’ll be watching how these capabilities develop as Motes rolls out. 🤝
celebrity.full_text_zh:

想象一下，有一个人工智能代理可以遵循您设定的策略。我感兴趣的是 @meetmotes 计划如何将该代理连接到 NFT 和智能帐户。

每个 Mote NFT 都被设计为代表与其自己的智能账户相关联的代理身份。

以下是各个部分如何组合在一起的：

prompts.title_zh: Cursor / Windsurf 工业级全栈架构 .cursorrules 规则模板
prompts.title_en: Production-Grade Fullstack .cursorrules Template for Cursor & Windsurf
prompts.scenario: 💻 编程研发 / 自动化规范
prompts.takeaway_zh: 杜绝 AI 盲目重构全量文件、使用已弃用 API 或编造虚假第三方依赖包，强制执行防御性编程与自动化单测补全。
prompts.takeaway_en: Prevents AI from hallucinating npm packages, breaking documentation, or re-writing entire files. Enforces defensive coding and unit tests.
prompts.code_snippet:
# Cursor & Windsurf Project Rules (.cursorrules)

## 1. Documentation & Code Integrity
- Maintain documentation integrity: Never strip or alter unrelated existing docstrings and comments.
- Preserving context: When modifying a function, preserve surrounding logic and existing edge-case handlers.
- Targeted replacements: Always make minimal surgical edits instead of replacing entire file contents.

## 2. Dependency & API Safety
- Strictly forbid hallucinating npm/pip packages. Only import dependencies already declared in package.json / requirements.txt.
- Verify API signatures before calling external methods. Prefer standard library solutions where feasible.

## 3. Architecture & Type Safety
- Enforce strict TypeScript / Python typing. Avoid `any` types; prefer discriminated unions and explicit return types.
- Defensive coding: Always validate external inputs and handle potential null/undefined values gracefully.

## 4. Testing & Verification Gate
- Every new core feature or bugfix must be accompanied by corresponding unit tests.
- Never declare a task complete without executing lint checks and unit tests in terminal.
prompts.usage_guide_zh: 将以上配置代码复制并保存到项目根目录下的 `.cursorrules` 文件中，Cursor 与 Windsurf 在每次生成代码和执行 Agent 任务时均会自动以此规范为最高准则约束输出。
prompts.usage_guide_en: Copy and save the above rules into `.cursorrules` in your project root directory. Cursor & Windsurf will automatically enforce these guidelines during agent coding.

prompts.title_zh: 💡【OpenAI 推理引擎】o1 / o3-mini 对抗性逆向验证：防偷懒、无漏洞的形式化推导模板
prompts.title_en: 💡 [OpenAI o1/o3-mini Spec] Adversarial Invalidation & Formal Mathematical Proof Template
prompts.author: OpenAI 研究院
prompts.temp_advice: 建议温度 1.0 (Reasoning 模型默认参数) | Effort: High
prompts.content_snippet: Adversarial verification prompt forcing OpenAI reasoning models to challenge intermediate proofs before presenting the final answer.
prompts.summary_zh: 强制 o1/o3 模型在思考链中构建对抗性反例，逐项排查边界条件，杜绝‘想当然’的不严密推理。
prompts.summary_en: Forces o1/o3 reasoning models to construct counter-examples at each deduction step, eliminating hidden logical leaps.
prompts.prompt_content_zh:
请作为普林斯顿高等研究院的理论数学与计算机科学家，为以下命题提供绝对严格的形式化证明：

prompts.code_snippet:
# 1. 启动项目自动化分析与上下文轻量修剪 (避免上下文爆炸)
claude --compact

# 2. 静默批量执行单元测试与自动修复任务 (CI/CD 友好模式)
claude -p "Run all failing tests under tests/ and apply minimal surgical fixes. Do not touch unrelated files."

# 3. 指定单文件隔离审查模式 (限制仅允许读取特定子目录)
claude --allowed-tools "View,Replace,RunCommand" \
  --dangerously-skip-permissions false \
  -p "Audit security vulnerabilities in auth.py and output remediation report."

# 4. 自动化提交并生成符合 Conventional Commits 规范的 Commit 信息
claude -p "Generate a git commit message following Conventional Commits format for staged changes."

prompts.summary_en: Production CLI playbook for Claude Code: non-interactive pipeline commands, context window compression flags, and strict dry-run permission safeguards.
prompts.prompt_content_zh:
# 1. 启动项目自动化分析与上下文轻量修剪 (避免上下文爆炸)
claude --compact

# 2. 静默批量执行单元测试与自动修复任务 (CI/CD 友好模式)
claude -p "Run all failing tests under tests/ and apply minimal surgical fixes. Do not touch unrelated files."

# 3. 指定单文件隔离审查模式 (限制仅允许读取特定子目录)
claude --allowed-tools "View,Replace,RunCommand" \
  --dangerously-skip-permissions false \
  -p "Audit security vulnerabilities in auth.py and output remediation report."

# 4. 自动化提交并生成符合 Conventional Commits 规范的 Commit 信息
claude -p "Generate a git commit message following Conventional Commits format for staged changes."

# 4. Automatically commit and generate Commit information that conforms to Conventional Commits specifications
claude -p "Generate a git commit message following Conventional Commits format for staged changes."

prompts.title_en: Excel Advanced Report & Key Drivers Attribution
prompts.purpose_zh: 业务数据指标异动排查与趋势归因
prompts.prompt_content_zh:
你是一名麦肯锡级别的高级商业数据分析师，精通结构化因果归因与杜邦拆解分析。

针对我提供的 {{业务指标}} 数据，其近期出现 {{异常表现}}，请按以下框架深度剖析：
1. 【指标公式拆解】：将该指标拆分为 3~4 个下级核心因子（如转化率、客单价、复购周期），指出哪个因子波动贡献率最大；
2. 【多维下钻 (Drill-down)】：从 {{维度拆解}}（如渠道、地域、品类、新老客）分析异常聚集点；
3. 【可执行建议】：摒弃假大空的套话，给出接下来 48 小时内的 3 个立竿见影的动作与 1 个监控预警公式。
prompts.prompt_content_en: You are a senior business intelligence analyst. Dissect the metric anomaly into component drivers, perform multi-dimensional drill-down, and deliver prioritized, actionable remediation steps.

sample_output.title: 归因分析报告样本：Q3 付费转化率环比下跌 14.2%
sample_output.content:
【核心发现】：GMV 下跌 14.2% 的主要驱动因子并非流量锐减，而是【结算跳失率】从 18% 飙升至 34%。

【杜邦拆解贡献率分析】：
1. 渠道维度：自然搜索量稳定（波动 <2%），但付费投流渠道跳出率贡献了 72% 的下跌额度；
2. 终端维度：移动端 iOS 表现正常，Android Web 呈现断崖式报错，核心原因是新版本结账 SDK 在低内存机型发生闪退。

【48小时纠偏行动】：
- 动作1 (技术)：立即灰度回滚 Android 渠道结账前端包至 v2.4.1；
- 动作2 (运营)：向受影响但未支付成功的 1,420 位加购用户推送 5 元免门槛补偿券唤醒；
- 动作3 (预警)：在 Grafana 建立警报公式：`IF(Cart_to_Checkout_Ratio < 0.65, Alert_P0, Normal)`。

prompts.code_snippet:
# Modelfile: Optimized DeepSeek-R1 Deployment
FROM deepseek-r1:14b-qwen-distill-q4_K_M

# 1. 显存与上下文窗口优化：分配 16k 上下文并开启 KV Cache 压缩
PARAMETER num_ctx 16384
PARAMETER num_predict 4096

# 2. 避免思维链自旋死循环的核心解码超参
PARAMETER temperature 0.6
PARAMETER top_p 0.95
PARAMETER repeat_penalty 1.15

# 3. 强力系统提示词：约束必须直接在 <think> 标签内进行深度反思，结束立刻给出最终结果
SYSTEM """
You are an expert autonomous reasoning AI. Think carefully through the problem step by step inside <think>...</think> tags.
Once reasoning is complete, provide the concise, direct, and actionable answer immediately without repeating reasoning steps.
"""

viral_posts.full_text_en:
Congrats to all my friends at @AnthropicAI. You have redefined the frontier of technology, while staying true to your values. 

I was lucky enough to get to know some of the early Anthropic folks almost a decade ago, when they joined us at @spc.

Tom Brown (@nottombrown) had spent eight years building mobile startups before he became a member in 2016. 

At SPC he joined our AI research group and implemented papers with some of our earliest members. Eight months later he was at OpenAI, and he even rejoined SPC for a bit before co-founding Anthropic. 

For Tom, -1 was about starting over and pushing the frontier, with the ambition that ultimately led to one of the most consequential technologies of our lifetime.

Thariq Shihipar (@trq212) spent time at SPC before joining the Claude Code team. Personally, Claude Code has been a floodgate of productivity. 

Thariq is an exceptional storyteller. Building great technology is not only an exercise in technical breakthroughs, but also in user education.

People find it weird that SPC's goal isn't just to get people to start companies. Our goal is to help people be maximally ambitious. 

Our thesis has always been that if you help people find their life's work, they will create something of immense value for humanity. 

Tom, Thariq - thank you for living these values and sharing your life's work with us!

My co-founders and I started Anthropic because we believe that the most powerful technology of our time should be built for the benefit of humankind.

Daniela and I lost our father to a disease that, just a few years later, became curable. I started my career in biology, hoping to help future cures come sooner. In the lab, I saw the vast thicket of complexity that scientists face when they’re trying to understand disease and develop new treatments.

So many of the scientific tools that can cut through that thicket—tools for gene editing, gene synthesis, controlling brain cells with light—started as pure ideas. In other words, they came from thinking. From intelligence.

Human intelligence has already made diseases like plague, smallpox, and polio history for most of the world. But progress on other diseases has been too slow for so many patients and their families. Going from a great idea to a treatment can take decades: it took many years from the first discovery of a strange repeating pattern in DNA to the approval of the first treatment for a disease using CRISPR.

Nature is full of these patterns. But we’ve had too little intelligence to decipher most of them; too few scientists, with too little time. Now we can build that intelligence. Whether it’s protein folding, drug design, cancer genetics, or clinical trial administration, scientists across many areas of biology and medicine are finding Claude can help them do their research in a fraction of the time it would’ve taken just a couple of years ago. I believe sufficiently powerful AI, working in concert with humans, could compress a century of scientific and medical progress into a decade.

I don’t want to get ahead of myself. At this point all we have are early results. Experiments and clinical trials will still take time. And although they involve slow and ponderous processes, I believe those processes can be substantially accelerated by AI. We hope that in the future fewer families miss a cure by just a few years.

Medicine is just a particularly vivid example, but there are many others. Our customers—the world’s most ambitious companies, nonprofits, and individual people—are already applying the intelligence we’ve built to stimulate economic growth; lift people out of poverty; protect democracy and free societies; even make everyday services like the DMV work better. We’re proud to work alongside them. And I’m extremely optimistic about what we can do together in the future.

At the same time, we have always been honest that this technology has very real risks. These range from misuse of the technology by individuals or nation-states, to economic disruption, to losing control of AI systems. We discuss these risks not because we think they are inevitable, but because we think they are avoidable.

Avoiding them depends on the choices made by the people building AI. There is a gigantic difference between how AI will go if we pay little attention to safety, versus how it will go if we are obsessed with safety. And an obsession with safety and with public benefit has been woven into Anthropic’s DNA from the start. From safeguards against biological and cyber risks, to alignment training and testing, to looking inside our models like an X-ray, Anthropic has pioneered methods for understanding and steering the behavior of AI systems.

There is much work still to be done, and the most difficult safety work lies ahead of us. The incredible talent of the company that has enabled us to build the most capable AI systems will need to be directed, even more so than it has already, towards double- and triple-checking that those AI systems are safe and secure.

And to state it unequivocally, we will pace the training and deployment of AI systems, taking as long as is necessary to have confidence that they are safe and will remain under human control. We will not bend to either business or political pressure. Today puts the company in a stronger financial position, and in doing so only strengthens our resolve to do the right thing.

If we can show it’s possible to make the right choices on safety and still build an incredibly successful company, others in our industry will be inspired to do the same. We call this a race to the top. When the race to the top is working properly, it doesn’t matter which company has the best models—everyone wins because everyone is building safely. The race to the top works best when driven from the front of the pack, and we fully hope and expect to do so, but the goal is to make the whole industry better, regardless of whether Anthropic is winning or losing at any given time.

The advent of machine intelligence is one of the seminal moments in human history, and we have a rare opportunity to shape it for the better.

This moment is bigger than any one company, or any one country. It will take all of us, working together, to ensure this technology goes well for us and the many generations to come. Starting today, we hope that you’ll join us on this mission.

Anthropic 首席执行官 @DarioAmodei 关于我们首次公开募股的评论：

我和我的联合创始人创立了 Anthropic，因为我们相信我们这个时代最强大的技术应该是为了造福人类而构建的。

丹妮拉和我的父亲因一种疾病去世，仅仅几年后，这种疾病就可以治愈。我的职业生涯始于生物学，希望能帮助未来的治愈方法早日到来。在实验室里，我看到了科学家在试图了解疾病和开发新疗法时所面临的巨大复杂性。

许多能够突破这一困境的科学工具——基因编辑、基因合成、用光控制脑细胞的工具——都是从纯粹的想法开始的。换句话说，它们来自于思考。来自智力。

人类智慧已经让世界上大部分地区的鼠疫、天花和脊髓灰质炎等疾病成为历史。但对于如此多的患者及其家人来说，其他疾病的进展太慢了。从一个伟大的想法到一种治疗方法可能需要数十年的时间：从首次发现 DNA 中奇怪的重复模式到第一个使用 CRISPR 治疗疾病的方法获得批准，花了很多年的时间。

大自然充满了这些模式。但我们的智慧太少，无法破译其中的大部分。科学家太少，时间太少。现在我们可以构建这种智能。无论是蛋白质折叠、药物设计、癌症遗传学还是临床试验管理，生物学和医学许多领域的科学家都发现克劳德可以帮助他们完成研究，所需时间只是几年前的一小部分。我相信足够强大的人工智能，与人类协同工作，可以将一个世纪的科学和医学进步压缩为十年。

我不想超越自己。目前我们所拥有的只是早期结果。实验和临床试验仍需要时间。尽管它们涉及缓慢而繁重的过程，但我相信人工智能可以大大加速这些过程。我们希望未来能有更少的家庭因仅仅几年的时间而错过治疗。

医学只是一个特别生动的例子，但还有很多其他例子。我们的客户——世界上最雄心勃勃的公司、非营利组织和个人——已经在应用我们构建的智能来刺激经济增长；让人们摆脱贫困；保护民主和自由社会；甚至让 DMV 等日常服务更好地运作。我们很自豪能与他们一起工作。我对我们未来可以一起做的事情非常乐观。

与此同时，我们一直诚实地认为这项技术存在非常现实的风险。这些问题包括个人或民族国家滥用技术、经济混乱、失去对人工智能系统的控制等。我们讨论这些风险不是因为我们认为它们是不可避免的，而是因为我们认为它们是可以避免的。

避免它们取决于构建人工智能的人们做出的选择。如果我们不关心安全，人工智能将会如何发展，而如果我们痴迷于安全，人工智能将会如何发展，两者之间存在着巨大的差异。对安全和公共利益的痴迷从一开始就融入了 Anthropic 的基因中。从防范生物和网络风险，到校准训练和测试，再到像 X 射线一样观察我们的模型，Anthropic 开创了理解和引导人工智能系统行为的方法。

任重而道远，最艰巨的安全工作还在后面。该公司拥有令人难以置信的人才，使我们能够构建最强大的人工智能系统，我们需要对其进行双重和三重检查，以确保这些人工智能系统的安全性，甚至比现在更加努力。

明确地说，我们将加快人工智能系统的训练和部署步伐，只要有必要，我们就确信它们是安全的，并将继续处于人类控制之下。我们不会屈服于商业或政治压力。今天，公司的财务状况变得更加强大，这样做只会增强我们做正确事情的决心。

如果我们能够证明我们可以在安全方面做出正确的选择，同时仍能打造一家极其成功的公司，那么我们行业的其他人也会受到启发，采取同样的做法。我们称之为登顶竞赛。当竞争顺利进行时，哪家公司拥有最好的模型并不重要——每个人都会赢，因为每个人都在安全地建造。当处于领先地位时，通往顶峰的竞争效果最好，我们完全希望并期望这样做，但目标是让整个行业变得更好，无论 Anthropic 在任何特定时间是赢还是输。

机器智能的出现是人类历史上的开创性时刻之一，我们有一个难得的机会来让它变得更好。

这一刻比任何一家公司或任何一个国家都重要。我们所有人都需要共同努力，才能确保这项技术为我们和子孙后代带来良好的发展。从今天开始，我们希望您能加入我们的行列。

viral_posts.full_text_en:
Good evening, fam 💜

Imagine having an AI agent that can follow a strategy you’ve set. What interests me is how @meetmotes plans to connect that agent to an NFT and a smart account.

Each Mote NFT is designed to represent an agent identity linked to its own smart account.

Here’s how the pieces fit together:

🔹 The NFT represents the agent’s identity.

🔹 The smart account is designed to hold assets and execute authorized actions.

🔹 The owner defines the instructions and permissions that guide the agent.

The idea is for the agent to help carry out supported actions within the owner’s chosen strategy, rather than the owner manually placing every trade.

For me, the important part is understanding the limits you’ve set. Automation can help carry out a strategy, but it doesn’t remove market risk or guarantee a profit.

I’ll be watching how these capabilities develop as Motes rolls out. 🤝
viral_posts.full_text_zh:

想象一下，有一个人工智能代理可以遵循您设定的策略。我感兴趣的是 @meetmotes 计划如何将该代理连接到 NFT 和智能帐户。

每个 Mote NFT 都被设计为代表与其自己的智能账户相关联的代理身份。

以下是各个部分如何组合在一起的：

🔹 NFT 代表了代理人的身份。

🔹 智能账户旨在持有资产并执行授权操作。

🔹 所有者定义指导代理的指令和权限。

这个想法是让代理帮助在所有者选择的策略内执行支持的操作，而不是所有者手动进行每笔交易。

对我来说，重要的是了解你设定的限制。自动化可以帮助执行策略，但它不能消除市场风险或保证利润。

随着 Motes 的推出，我将关注这些功能如何发展。 🤝
